g.text: PR #2402 · Dispatch queued work at idle
Queued work waited at idle and could run during another turn.
One dispatch decision now waits for work to finish and pauses on failed turns.
BEFORE
AFTER
is_awaiting == true
A completed turn means awaiting user input.
Both queue gates treat that idle state as busy.
is_awaiting == false
Work in progress can pass the inverted guard.
Buttons and queue drain repeat the same mistake.
ActivityTag::Result
Failed Claude/Codex results can look successful.
The active work item can be marked completed.
latest_turn_activity / EditStackDispatch
Working holds; awaiting input sends the next item.
No activity still permits the first prompt.
edit_stack_dispatch
Buttons and drain share Busy / Drained / Send(id).
Active items, permissions and pending sends still hold.
reconcile_edit_stack_activity
Failed terminal results pause Send All.
Manual sending can resume explicitly from idle.
Scope: frontend queue policy and terminal classification. Durable operation IDs and exactly-once scheduling are separate work.
